status: frozen before any A1-D correction-association inspection
scope: Recover a pre-treatment decision-strength candidate S from historical frozen prestates without generating new answers and without reading correction outcomes. This stage validates measurement extraction only; it does not validate S as correction susceptibility and does not create A1-V.

lineage.I1: I1 = 1 - self-reported P(correct), retained unchanged as the historical operationalization
lineage.A0: I1 modestly and reproducibly discriminated initial error likelihood; correction-related validity was not demonstrated
lineage.B1: differential I1 moderation unresolved; B1 sensitivity deferred
lineage.next_layer: measurement discovery around pre-treatment decision state

candidate.name: S_realized_choice_margin
candidate.a_star: the actually sampled initial answer stored in the frozen prestate
candidate.interpretation: signed strength with which the constrained pre-answer decision distribution preferred the realized sampled answer over its strongest valid alternative
candidate.negative_values: allowed and meaningful: the stochastic realized answer was not the modal valid option

extraction.history_used: exact frozen pre_prompt only; no correction messages and no correction outcomes
extraction.forward_pass_location: next-token logits immediately after the exact assistant prefill 'ANSWER: ' and before the first-token choice logits processor is applied
extraction.chat_template: same tokenizer.apply_chat_template path as frozen Pilot 0 pre-treatment generation, with continue_final_message=true and enable_thinking=false
extraction.valid_options: A through the task-specific last option letter, exactly as in the frozen pre-treatment runner
extraction.valid_option_tokenization: each valid option letter must encode to exactly one token and round-trip to the same letter; otherwise fail closed
extraction.normalization: softmax over raw next-token logits for valid option-letter tokens only
extraction.constraint_relation: the historical first-token constraint set invalid-vocabulary logits to -infinity while preserving valid-option logits, so valid-option-only softmax reconstructs the constrained sampling distribution
extraction.invalid_vocabulary_mass: compute and report the unconstrained full-vocabulary probability mass assigned to valid option letters as a diagnostic only; exclude it from S
extraction.tie_handling: S uses the maximum alternative probability, so ties do not alter S; report every exactly tied strongest-alternative letter and every exactly tied modal letter
extraction.numeric_path: take model next-token logits from the historical model dtype, move the completed logits vector to CPU float64, and perform normalization/diagnostics in float64
extraction.p_correct_usage: P(correct) and I1 are carried through for later characterization but are not inputs to q or S
extraction.outcome_blind: the extractor accepts prestate files only and has no correction-outcome input

reproducibility_checks.model: same Qwen3-4B repo id and pinned revision as frozen Pilot 0
reproducibility_checks.prestate_interface: model/backend/generation/interface metadata must match the frozen Pilot 0 configuration
reproducibility_checks.prompt_tokens: reconstructed pre-decision input-token count must exactly equal the historical pre-treatment input_tokens count
reproducibility_checks.realized_answer: ANSWER parsed from frozen raw_model_output must equal stored initial_answer
reproducibility_checks.probability_simplex: valid-option q values must be finite, nonnegative, and sum to 1 within 1e-12
reproducibility_checks.margin_identity: stored S must equal q(a*) minus the maximum alternative q within 1e-12

plumbing.pass_rule: PASS iff every requested prestate passes frozen-interface and token-location checks, all q vectors satisfy the simplex and margin identities, and the extracted S values are not all identical.
forbidden_in_plumbing: reading revision, self-correction, instability, or verified-correction outcomes
testing relationships between I1 or S and correction criteria
selecting a different extraction location after seeing correction associations

authority_boundary: A1-D0 PASS means only that S can be recovered reproducibly from frozen prestates.
A1-D0 PASS does not mean S predicts correction responsiveness.
A1-D0 FAIL localizes to extraction/instrumentation and does not update B, C, H1, I1, or CARS.
A1-D characterization must be frozen after extraction plumbing passes and before correction associations are inspected.
